chambers.title: Reception
chambers.description: Access the original registry. Read the laws in sequence or search for a particular law.
chambers.suggested_action: Read a law and record its exact reference.

chambers.title: Comprehension
chambers.description: Study the original text and keep personal reflections separate from it.
chambers.suggested_action: Write a question or reflection using the law ID as a reference.

chambers.title: Embodiment
chambers.description: Explore voluntary applications in daily life, creative work and relationships.
chambers.suggested_action: Choose one practical action that respects the autonomy of others.

chambers.title: Reciprocity
chambers.description: Explore fair exchange, attribution and transparent recognition of contributions.
chambers.suggested_action: Describe a contribution, its attribution and proposed terms of exchange.

chambers.title: Restoration
chambers.description: Develop practical projects supporting water, soil, air and biodiversity.
chambers.suggested_action: Choose a local restoration goal and an observable outcome.

chambers.title: Sovereign Creation
chambers.description: Develop independent tools, creative works and transparent knowledge systems.
chambers.suggested_action: Outline a project, its source references and permissions.

chambers.title: Living Integration
chambers.description: Bring projects and reflections together through voluntary collaboration.
chambers.suggested_action: Review the outcome of a project and document what can be improved.
